explicit_validation.explanation: The paper explicitly validates DeepSeek-V3 autorater against GPT-4o Mini human evaluation by comparing ratings on a sample of 710 summary outputs and reporting Pearson correlation

prompts.notes: Prompts described as validated for correlation with human annotations (Liu et al., 2025), exact prompts referenced in Appendix A Figure

guidelines.notes: Human annotators evaluated three questions with 3-point scale (1-Not at all; 2-Somewhat; 3-Completely)

sample_size.notes: Sample of 710 output summaries re-evaluated by both DeepSeek-V3 and GPT-4o Mini

quantitative_scores.notes: Correlation between ratings given by GPT-4o mini and DeepSeek-V3

validation_results.summary_finding: DeepSeek-V3 autorater shows strong correlation (Pearson r=73.29) with GPT-4o Mini human evaluation, indicating robustness of the LLM-as-judge evaluation setup.

criteria_mapping.notes: LLM focuses on relevance and consistency, while human evaluation includes additional aspects like question addressing and structure
